prepare.question: How will you frame the Q4 gross margin outlook of 72.0%, down 90 basis points sequentially, as the rollout of AI-based features expands across the platform?
How will you present the full-year Adjusted EBITDA outlook of $323 million, a 26.5% margin and $3 million higher, alongside the expected Q4 gross margin pressure?
How will you explain moving existing Max individual subscribers to the Super family plan at the same price, and what this means for revenue per subscriber?
How will you describe Q4 bookings being slightly ahead of the guidance implied by the previous full-year outlook without giving a new numeric range?
How will you set expectations that Q4 DAU growth is similar to Q3's 29% year-over-year, following acceleration from 23% in Q2?
How will you explain subscription bookings growing 16% year over year against total bookings growth of 12% in Q3?
How will you present the swing from a $245.7 million tax benefit in Q3 2025 to an $8.4 million tax provision in Q3 2026, so the prior-year valuation allowance release is not misread?
